title: Independent-model broad-corpus split
description: Cross-language comparison with gpt-5.6-terra on the frozen twelve-task iteration-021 corpus after contextual number in Parley 0.3.155.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict parity under the independent model.

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-model Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-terra.
Iteration 021 used gpt-5.6-sol and Parley 0.3.154, so cross-iteration movement cannot be attributed separately to model or compiler.
The exact corpus reuse is authorized only as the preregistered model split in iteration 021's stop rule; do not tune syntax against it after output.
Audit whether the ten contextual-number failures disappear, but do not construct a counterfactual token claim from different sessions.
secondary_analysis: Report all sessions, task outcomes, repairs, prompt and source sizes, tokens, elapsed time, integrity, and protocol compliance.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure, including recurrence by unrelated task and independence by session.
Compare failure signatures with iteration 021 descriptively and state that both model and compiler changed.
Report repair-free sensitivity if at least two Parley sessions pass every task on the first check.
feature_boundary: Parley is frozen at v0.3.155. Relative to iteration 021, only value-level contextual identifier number changed. No grammar operation, AST, runtime, skill, prompt, task, or checker protocol changed.
change_rule: No syntax or compiler behavior may be added from one task, transcript, session, or token gap. A proposal requires independent recurrence across unrelated tasks plus general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability. Checker-totality defects remain correctness bugs.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
stop_rule: Preserve the complete result. After output, do not alter the compiler from this reused corpus unless a newly observed checker-totality defect is independently reproducible; future ergonomics evidence must move to a new corpus.
